title: 第152章 一叶第151章 虐杀
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
第一卷第152章一叶
洛还真要让他们明白一个道理——
很多时候做了坏事，不是道歉悔过就可以揭过一切的，有些罪孽，必须用死亡，才能偿还。
什么虐身虐心都是假的。
在洛还真的价值观里，剥夺他们性命是对坏人最大的责罚。
而远处的凌鹰。
在失去主人的一瞬间，身体的禁制也全都松开了。
妖兽虽然会听命于主人，与主人一体，以主人的利益为自己的利益。
但前提是主仆契约在的情况下。
现在两个主人一死，它也失去了来自两人下达的反抗指令。
于是，直接扑棱一下朝着洛还真的方向跪了下来。
不敢跑，根本不敢跑。
它可追不上这个飘在空中，虎视眈眈的莲花法器。
洛还真甩了甩拳头上的血渍，走向跪在地上人性化朝自己磕头的凌鹰。
它只是个金丹期的妖兽。
还不能口吐人言说话，只能发出“啾啾啾”的声音。
洛还真蹲下来，“什么？你说什么，本尊听不懂。”
凌鹰继续啾啾啾，翅膀子不断比划，指指洛还真又指指自己。
洛还真思考了一会儿，明白了它的意思。
它想要活命，它愿意让洛还真契约，给她打工。

洛还真摇头。
“抱歉，本尊不需要灵宠。赶路本尊有小莲花了，至于陪伴的宠物……我也不喜欢你。”
洛还真脑子里想到的是小黑。
它才是她喜欢的小伙伴。
可以一起吃东西，一起玩耍，一起做喜欢做的事情。
他俩之间的契约还存在着，哪怕相隔这么远的距离，洛还真也能感受到自己和小黑之间的联系。
凌鹰看洛还真这个样子，有点着急了。
她说的话很有道理，这个人类小修士好像看不大上自己。
它左右比划，继续发出“啾啾啾”的求饶声，想表达自己并不是主动跟着那两个修士的。
它在还是颗蛋的时候就被他俩契约了。
只要不听话就要被惩罚。
作为修士的灵宠，它甚至就连自杀都做不到，所以才帮着他们做了很多事情。
洛还真神情没有什么变化。
她眼神坚定而冷漠地朝凌鹰伸手。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 152 One Leaf
Luo really wants them to understand one thing——
Many times when you do bad things, you can't just apologize and repent. Some sins can only be repaid by death.
All the abuse of body and mind is fake.
In Luo Huanzhen's values, depriving them of their lives is the greatest punishment for bad guys.
And the Lingying in the distance.
The moment he lost his master, all the restraints on his body were loosened.
Although the monster beast will obey the command of the master, become one with the master, and regard the master's interests as its own interests.
But the premise is that the master-servant contract exists.
Now that the two owners are dead, it also loses the resistance instructions given by the two.
So, he knelt down in the direction of Luo Huanzhen.
Don't dare to run, don't dare to run at all.
It can't catch up with this lotus magic weapon floating in the air, staring at it with eager eyes.
Luo Huazhen shook off the blood stains on his fists and walked towards Ling Ying, who was kneeling on the ground and kowtowed to him in a humane manner.
It's just a golden elixir stage monster.
He is still unable to speak human words, and can only make "chirp, chirp, chirp" sounds.
Luo Huanzhen squatted down, "What? I don't understand what you said."
Lingying continued to chirp, gesticulating with his wings, pointing at Luo Huazhen and then at himself.
Luo really thought about it for a while and understood what it meant.
It wanted to live, and it was willing to let Luo Huanzhen make a contract and work for her.
Luo really shook his head.
"Sorry, I don't need a spiritual pet. I have a little lotus on my way. As for the companion pet... I don't like you either."
Luo Huanzhen was thinking of Xiao Hei.
It is her favorite little friend.
You can eat together, play together, and do the things you like to do together.
The contract between them still existed, and even though they were so far apart, Luo Huan really could feel the connection between himself and Xiao Hei.
Ling Ying was a little anxious seeing Luo really like this.
What she said made sense. This little human monk seemed to think little of her.
It gestured left and right and continued to make "chirp, chirp, chirp" begging sounds, trying to express that it was not actively following the two monks.
It was contracted by them when it was still an egg.
Anyone who disobeys will be punished.
As the monk's spiritual pet, it can't even commit suicide, so it helps them do many things.
Luo Huanzhen's expression didn't change much.
She reached out to Ling Ying with firm and cold eyes.
